changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.comment: The column is created NOT NULL, but databases whose DW_RECOMMENDATION predates it received it nullable, outside Liquibase. PostgreSQL names a NOT NULL constraint after the column it guards, so the constraint the renames below look for exists only where the column is NOT NULL.

changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.comment: A constraint keeps the name it was created with when its table or column is renamed, so these still carried the name of the recommendation value they used to be. PostgreSQL names a NOT NULL constraint itself, ignoring the name the changelog asks for, which is why these are not the NL_ names declared there.
